children: Direct electricity supply from the Heringen-Philippsthal wind park to K+S’s Werra production site has commenced. The 11.4 MW wind park was sold to MPC in 2022; Energiekontor developed it and supports the arrangement.
Direct supply to K+S has commenced
The operating arrangement connects renewable generation directly to an industrial customer, but the release gives no contract value or revenue impact.
Provides the scale of the project; no prior-period comparison or financial contribution was provided.
Energiekontor sold the wind park to MPC in 2022
Energiekontor is supporting the supply arrangement for an asset it no longer owns, rather than adding owned generation capacity.

This is an operational milestone for a wind park developed by Energiekontor and sold in 2022, rather than a new owned asset. Further customer agreements, quantified economics, or adoption of similar direct-wire PPAs would be needed to establish a larger business catalyst.
Based on the original press release from Energiekontor AG distributed by EQS.
